question: Will NATO forces shoot down or destroy a Russian drone or aircraft over NATO territory between October 1 and October 2, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Empirical base rate dominates: in the last 90 days there were ~5 qualifying downing-days over NATO land/territorial sea (Jul 24/25/26 Romania, Aug 16 Romania, Sep 15 Lithuania), clustered into 3 episodes. Direct count of non-overlapping 2-day windows containing a downing gives ~9%; trailing-12-month framing gives ~4%, trailing-60-day gives ~13%. I anchor on the recent regime (~1-2 qualifying events/month) because the trend is clearly upward: zero downings Jan-Apr 2026, Romania's first-ever in July, Lithuania's first-ever on 15 Sep, 23 Romanian airspace violations in 2026 vs 18 in all of 2022-25. Upward adjustments for the autumn strike campaign on Odesa/Danube ports abutting Romania and a permissive criterion (any NATO member; stray Ukrainian drones count; EW-forced-down counts). Downward for the bare 2-day window, the fact that most incursions still end without kinetic engagement (drone flew 30 min over Romania unimpeded 9 Sep; Romania scrambled without downing 15 Sep), and a modest chance active US-brokered talks dampen air activity. No market with matching criteria exists; the expired Polymarket 'NATO downs a Russian drone' contract counted jamming and had no over-NATO-territory clause, so it is evidence, not an anchor. Land at ~10%.

EVENT WINDOW: 00:00 UTC 1 Oct 2026 -> 23:59 UTC 2 Oct 2026 (48 hours), per the resolution criteria text. As of Now (2026-09-21T18:32Z) the window has not opened: 0% elapsed, it begins in ~9.2 days. Scheduled resolution 2026-10-03.

RESOLUTION INSTRUMENT: resolves off a confirmed KINETIC downing (missile, gun, destruction in air, or EW that forces the object down) of a UAV or crewed military aircraft while it is over the LAND or TERRITORIAL SEA of a NATO member, reported by NATO officials or credible sources, with the object characterised as Russian/Belarusian or as linked to Russia's war on Ukraine. NOT off: scrambles, escorts, jamming without a downing, drones that merely crash or are recovered, downings over international waters/Ukraine/Russia. A maritime (surface) drone is not a UAV. Attribution may be disputed and still count if credible sources make the Russia link.

STATUS-QUO OUTCOME: on a randomly chosen 48-hour window in this period, NATO forces scramble jets and/or record airspace violations but do not kinetically down anything over alliance territory; the window passes with no qualifying downing.

EVIDENCE (both directions):
- 15 Sep 2026: Italian Eurofighter on Baltic Air Policing downed a drone that crossed from Belarus near Pratkunai, Kaisiadorys district, central Lithuania; Lithuanian defence minister said it carried an explosive. First drone ever downed over Lithuania. (Al Jazeera, NPR, Stars and Stripes, 15 Sep 2026)
- 16 Aug 2026: Spanish F-18 on NATO air policing downed a suspected Russian drone ~24 km north of Galati, Romania, 17 minutes after radar detection; drone entered via Moldova. Fourth drone interception over Romania in 2026 and the first flown by an ally rather than the host nation. (Aerotime, Euronews, Brussels Signal, 16 Aug 2026)
- 24, 25 and 26 Jul 2026: three Romanian F-16 downings on three consecutive days; the 24 Jul event was the first-ever interception over Romanian airspace; one was identified as a Shahed-model airframe; the 26 Jul engagement occurred over the Black Sea five minutes after the object entered Romanian airspace (location relative to the 12nm territorial sea not stated in reporting). (Washington Post, Al Jazeera, Moscow Times, Stars and Stripes, 24-27 Jul 2026)
- ~20 Aug 2026: Romanian F-16 destroyed an explosive-laden MARITIME drone near the Neptun Deep offshore gas project, hours after a separate aerial drone entered Romanian airspace and crashed near the Ukrainian border. (Euronews, 20 Aug 2026)
- 19 May 2026: a Romanian jet on a NATO contingent shot down a suspected Ukrainian drone over Estonia between Vortsjarv and Poltsamaa, part of a March/May 2026 series of Ukrainian or suspected-Ukrainian drones entering Baltic/Finnish airspace, attributed by officials to Russian electronic warfare. (Wikipedia '2026 Ukrainian drone incursions into the Baltic states and Finland')
- 9 Sep 2026: a Russian attack drone reportedly flew roughly 30 minutes over Romania without being engaged. (question background)
- 15 Sep 2026: Romania scrambled two F-16s over a drone breaching its airspace during a Russian attack near the border, and Poland deployed Polish and allied aircraft and temporarily closed Lublin airport - neither produced a downing that day. (Sofia Globe, 15 Sep 2026)
- 26 Feb 2026 (Oresund) and 25 Apr 2026 (British Eurofighters authorised to neutralise a drone but returned to base without engaging) are documented cases where NATO forces encountered drones and did NOT engage kinetically. (Wikipedia airspace-violations article)
- 10 Sep 2025 (Poland): ~19-23 Russian drones entered Polish airspace; allied aircraft (Poland, Netherlands, Germany, Italy) downed 3-4. First time NATO fired shots since the 2022 invasion; Poland invoked Article 4. This remains the only mass-incursion-plus-downing event on record. (NPR, Moscow Times, NBC, Wikipedia)
- 12 Aug 2026: North Atlantic Council statement on airspace violations in Poland and Romania; Allies said Russia bears full responsibility and underlined reinforced integrated air and missile defence 'from the Baltic to the Black Sea'. NATO's Eastern Sentry launched Sep 2025; enhanced air policing over Poland, Bulgaria, Romania. (nato.int, 12 Aug 2026)
- Driver of spillover: Russia struck the Orlivka-Isaccea Danube ferry crossing on the Romanian border on 1 and 6 Sep 2026, and hit Odesa port/energy infrastructure in large barrages overnight 11-12 Sep and again 16 Sep 2026, suspending Romania-Ukraine ferry service. Strike corridors run adjacent to Romanian airspace. (Kyiv Independent, Meduza, USNews, Sep 2026)
- Diplomatic track: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in Moscow on ~5 Sep 2026 (3+ hours, no announced breakthrough) then travelled to Kyiv; Ukrainian units were reportedly ordered to halt fighting 5-8 Sep. Earlier 2026 saw short truces (32-hour Orthodox Easter truce 11 Apr; 9-11 May Victory Day truce). No formal ceasefire agreed; sticking points are Donbas territory and Western security guarantees. Lithuania's defence minister said on 15 Sep that incidents would persist absent a negotiated settlement. (Al Jazeera, Kyiv Independent, Kyiv Post, Wikipedia)
- Ongoing high aerial-war intensity in both directions: Russian MoD claimed 244 Ukrainian drones downed over Russian regions overnight 20-21 Sep 2026 and 1,110 on 19-20 Sep; 120 over Rostov oblast alone on 20 Sep; 15 over Ufa on 21 Sep. (Russian MoD via AIF, Tsargrad, Vzglyad, 20-21 Sep 2026)

BASE RATES FOUND:
- Over ALL 2026 to date (1 Jan - 21 Sep, 264 days): 6 calendar days containing a qualifying downing over NATO land/territorial sea (19 May, 24/25/26 Jul, 16 Aug, 15 Sep) = ~2.3% of days; zero in Jan-Apr.
- Over the LAST 90 DAYS ONLY (23 Jun - 21 Sep): 5 downing-days = ~5.6% of days, clustered into 3 distinct episodes (one 3-day July cluster, two singletons). Counting non-overlapping 2-day windows, ~4 of 45 contained a downing.
- Over the LAST 60 DAYS: 5 downing-days in 60.
- CONDITIONAL on an airspace violation occurring, Romania 2026: 2
calls.reference_class: Two-day calendar windows on NATO's eastern flank during the 2026 escalation regime (May-Sep 2026), asking whether the window contains at least one kinetic downing of a Russia-linked drone/aircraft over NATO land or territorial sea

calls.reasoning: Base rate from the 2026 record: 8 aerial kinetic downings over NATO land/territorial sea between May 19 and Sep 21 (Estonia 5/19, Latvia 6/8, Romania 7/24-7/26 x3, Latvia 8/14, Romania 8/16, Lithuania 9/15). Counting two-day windows directly, ~14/125 windows since May 19 contained a downing (11%); in the post-Ankara regime (Jul 1+, engagement authority delegated to SACEUR/CAOC) ~10/82 (12%). Incursions vastly outnumber downings (Romania: 23 violations, 4 downings by mid-August; unengaged crossings on 7/30, 9/9, 9/17), so the downing rate, not the incursion rate, is the right anchor. Adjusted modestly up for the rising trend, pre-authorized shoot-down orders, the autumn ramp in Russian mass strikes near the Romanian/Polish border, and record Ukrainian drone volumes that produce EW-diverted strays into the Baltics; adjusted down for burstiness (clustered events make a random quiet window more likely) and a relatively quiet last five weeks. No matching prediction market exists; the nearest Polymarket contract (any means, no territory clause, open-ended window) is not comparable.

- Running record of incursions (grosswald.org, page updated 2026-09-18) lists 2026 downings over NATO territory: May 19 Estonia (Romanian F-16, Baltic Air Policing); Jun 8 Latvia (French Rafale); Jul 24 Romania (Shahed-type, Romanian F-16 via NATO CAOC); Jul 25-26 Romania (two more, Romanian F-16s); Aug 14 Latvia (Italian Eurofighter, diverted Ukrainian drone); Aug 16 Romania (Spanish F-18); Aug 20 Romania (SEA drone destroyed by cannon fire near Neptun Deep gas works - maritime, offshore); Sep 15 Lithuania (Italian Eurofighter, Gerbera near Kruonis).
- Same source records incursions that were NOT engaged: Apr 24-25 Romania; May 7 Latvia (drone struck Rezekne oil depot); May 29 Romania (Geran-2 struck apartment block, F-16s cleared but did not fire); Jul 30 Poland (Kh-101 came down ~100km inside border, not engaged); Aug 1 Estonia (~10 drones, Turkish F-16s scrambled, no firing); Aug 4 Germany (explosive drone found at Leipzig/Halle); Sep 1 Germany; Sep 17 Poland (fast object came down 4km inside Ukraine; pre-authorized shoot-down had been issued).
- Wikipedia '2026 Ukrainian drone incursions into the Baltic states and Finland' (accessed 2026-09-21) independently confirms the May 19, Jun 8, Aug 14 and Sep 15 interceptions and lists many additional non-intercepted incursions in Mar/May (Lithuania Mar 23, Estonia+Latvia Mar 25, Finland Mar 29 & May 3, Latvia May 7/17/23, Lithuania May 17/20/21). Several of these objects are attributed to Ukrainian-origin drones pushed off course by Russian EW.

Romania's 2026 violation count already exceeds the 18 recorded across 2022-2025 combined. Romania's MoD says it cannot conclude the increase is a deliberate targeting campaign; recovered fragments were Russian-origin.

Poland issued a pre-authorized shoot-down order on Sep 17, 2026 (object came down inside Ukraine). NATO has announced no blanket 'engage all violators' rule; engagement decisions remain real-time and threat-based per NATO statements.
- NAC statements (nato.int, 2026-08-12) condemned repeated airspace violations over Poland and Romania.
- Wider theatre tempo, Sep 20-21, 2026 (Russian MoD via AIF/Tsargrad/Vzglyad): Russia claims 244 Ukrainian drones downed over 16 Russian regions the night of Sep 20-21 and ~1,110 the night of Sep 19-20; 120 over Rostov oblast, 15 over Ufa. Drone-war volume on both sides is at record levels.
- Diplomacy: US envoys (Witkoff, Kushner) visited Moscow in early Sep 2026; a three-day limited ceasefire was announced and had limited effect; talks remain deadlocked over territory and security guarantees (Al Jazeera, 2026-09-05). No ceasefire in force as of Now.
- Non-qualifying adjacent incidents showing the escalation backdrop: Russian frigate fired flares at a Danish helicopter (Sep 15, 2026); a Russia-linked drone came near a plane carrying Zelensky to Norway (~Sep 10, 2026); Feb 26, 2026 Oresund incident, Swedish forces jammed a Russian UAV launched from a Russian intelligence ship near the carrier Charles de Gaulle (jamming only, no confirmed downing; over the strait).

calls.reference_class: Two-day calendar windows in 2026 since the first NATO kinetic downing of the year (May 19 - Sep 21), asking whether the window contained at least one kinetic downing of a war-linked drone over NATO land/territorial-sea territory

calls.reasoning: Status quo is NO: a specific 2-day window rarely contains a kinetic downing. Reference class = 2-day windows in 2026 containing >=1 NATO kinetic downing of a Russian/war-linked drone over NATO soil. Eight such event days occurred 1 Jan-21 Sep 2026 (grosswald running record), giving 14/262 windows = 5.3% YTD, but the process is clearly non-stationary: zero downings Jan-Apr, six since 1 July, which yields 10/82 = 12.2% over the current regime. Upward adjustments: Russia running 450-500-drone nights against Volyn/Lviv within km of the Polish border (12-13, 17 Sep); Poland's pre-authorised shoot-down order of 17 Sep and post-Lithuania NATO hardening raise P(kinetic engagement | incursion); the criterion is broad (EW-diverted Ukrainian drones, Belarus-origin objects, territorial seas, ~8 exposed members). Downward: only one downing in the last five weeks, most incursions still end in escort/observation rather than a kill, and no catalyst is scheduled on 1-2 Oct. Landing just at the current-regime rate.
calls.dossier:
RESOLUTION INSTRUMENT: resolves off a confirmed KINETIC downing (missile, gun, EW takedown that forces the object down, destruction in the air) by NATO forces or a NATO member's armed forces, over the LAND or TERRITORIAL-SEA territory of a NATO member, reported by NATO officials or credible sources. It does NOT resolve off scrambles, escorts, jamming without a downing, a drone merely crashing or being recovered, or downings over international waters / Ukraine / Russia / Belarus. Object must be characterised as Russian, as originating from Russia or Belarus, or as linked to Russia's war on Ukraine (EW-diverted Ukrainian drones have been so characterised in past cases).

EVENT WINDOW: 2026-10-01T00:00Z -> 2026-10-02T23:59Z per the criteria (2 days). As of Now 2026-09-21T18:32Z, 0% elapsed; window opens in ~9.2 days.

STATUS-QUO OUTCOME (what happens if nothing changes): no kinetic downing occurs inside a given 2-day window; incursions that do occur are typically tracked, escorted or left unengaged.

BASE RATES (source: grosswald.org running record of Russian drone/missile incursions into NATO territory, read 2026-09-21; cross-checked against ABC News 2026-08 and LRT/Breaking Defense/Stripes reporting):
- Over ALL 2-day windows 1 Jan-21 Sep 2026 (263 days, 8 distinct event days): 14 of 262 windows contained an event = 5.3%.
- Over 2-day windows in the CURRENT REGIME 1 Jul-21 Sep 2026 (83 days, 6 event days): 10 of 82 = 12.2%.
- Over 2-day windows in the LAST FIVE WEEKS 17 Aug-21 Sep 2026 (36 days, 1 event day): 2 of 35 = 5.7%.
- Conditional on an incursion occurring, the share ending in a kinetic downing is low: Romania logged 23 airspace violations in 2026 by 17 Aug (vs 18 total across 2022-2025) but only 4 downings; NATO flew 42+ air-policing missions over Romania in 2026.
- Monthly distribution of downings in 2026: Jan-Apr 0, May 1, Jun 1, Jul 3, Aug 2, Sep 1 (through 21 Sep).

EVENT LIST (each = NATO kinetic downing over NATO territory, 2026): 19 May Estonia, Romanian F-16, EW-diverted Ukrainian drone (first over Estonia). 8 Jun Latvia (Berzgale), French Rafale. 24 Jul Romania (Buzau), Romanian F-16, Shahed-type. 25 Jul Romania (Sfantu Gheorghe), Romanian F-16. 26 Jul Romania (territorial waters off Sulina), Romanian F-16, explosive-laden drone. 14 Aug Latvia (Balvi), Italian Eurofighter, drone pushed off course by Russian EW. 16 Aug Romania (Galati area), Spanish F-18. 15 Sep Lithuania (Kaisiadorys/Pratkunai), Italian Eurofighter, armed Gerbera-type drone from Belarus, ~30 min airborne, first ever over Lithuania. Prior precedent: 10 Sep 2025 Poland, ~21 drones entered, Polish F-16s and Dutch F-35s downed at least 3 (first NATO kinetic engagement in allied airspace).

EVIDENCE POINTING TOWARD MORE ACTIVITY IN EARLY OCTOBER:
- Russia launched ~450-500 strike drones per night against Ukraine on 12-13 Sep, including rare mass attacks on Volyn and Rivne and strikes on Stryi in Lviv oblast bordering Poland (Euronews / Kyiv Independent, 13 Sep 2026).
- 17 Sep 2026: Russian jet-powered drone struck Volyn several km from the Yahodyn crossing; Polish F-16s scrambled and a pre-authorised shoot-down order was issued; no violation confirmed (grosswald record; Mezha).
- 13 Sep 2026: Geran-5 jet drones struck 1 km and 5 km from the Polish border per Polish Defence Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz.
- NATO is weighing converting Baltic air policing into a full air-DEFENCE mission with looser engagement rules (Yahoo/AFP; NAOC analysis, Sep 2026).
- Lithuania recorded 22 smuggling drones in its airspace in the first 13 days of September 2026 (Belarus-origin objects are inside the criterion's wording).
- Romanian MFA and a former Romanian MoD official publicly project continued escalation: Russia will 'keep trying, keep pushing, keep testing' (ABC News, Aug 2026).
- Autumn is historically when Russia's campaign against Ukrainian energy infrastructure intensifies, concentrating strikes on western oblasts adjacent to Poland/Romania.

EVIDENCE POINTING THE OTHER WAY:
- 9 Sep 2026: a Russian attack drone reportedly transited Romanian airspace for ~30 minutes with no engagement.
- 17 Sep 2026 Poland: aircraft scrambled, air defence raised to heightened readiness, no airspace violation and no engagement.
- 29 Jul 2026: an armed drone/cruise missile fell ~50 km from Lublin in Polish territory without being brought down by NATO (a crash, not a downing - would not satisfy the criterion).
- Only one downing has occurred in the 36 days from 17 Aug to 21 Sep, after a dense Jul-Aug run, consistent with clustering rather than a permanently higher level.
- Downings cluster tightly (24-26 Jul consecutive; 14 and 16 Aug), so independent-Poisson reasoning overstates the per-window hit rate.
- No NATO/EU summit, ministerial or other scheduled driver was found for 1-2 Oct 2026 (searched EU Council, EPC and NATO calendars: absent).

MARKET STATE: the harness title-searched Polymarket and Manifold and found no candidate market; my own search found no contract matching the 1-2 Oct window or the kinetic-only fine print. A monthly Polymarket series 'Will NATO down another Russian drone?' exists but its August instance resolved on downing 'by any means, including... electronic jamming' over a whole month - threshold, window and fine print all differ, so it is not a usable anchor. Polymarket's adjacent 'NATO x Russia military clash' contract explicitly excludes interception of loitering munitions aimed at a third party, so it is not the same event either. No Kalshi or bookmaker contract located.

SEARCHED BUT NOT FOUND: any incident between 18 and 21 Sep 2026; any official NATO announcement of new standing engagement authority taking effect before 1 Oct; a per-month tally of incursions across all NATO members (only Romania-specific counts are published); any scheduled political or military event on 1-2 Oct 2026; any prediction market with matching terms.
calls.reference_class: Two-day calendar windows in 2026 containing at least one NATO kinetic downing of a Russian/Belarusian/war-linked drone over NATO land or territorial-sea territory

calls.reasoning: Reconciled on the 8-event 2026 downing list (Runs 2 and 3, corroborated), not Run 1's 6 — Run 1 missed 8 Jun Latvia and 14 Aug Latvia, biasing its rate low. Anchor is the post-Ankara regime (1 Jul-21 Sep): 6 downing-days in 83 = 0.072/day, ~10/82 two-day windows = 12%, with a clustering discount against the 13.9% Poisson figure. Small upward tilt for the autumn Russian campaign against western-Ukraine energy adjacent to Poland/Romania, rising incursion counts, and looser engagement authority (Ankara delegation, Poland's 17 Sep pre-authorised shoot-down order); offset by only one downing in the last 36 days and the fact that most incursions still end unengaged (30-min unimpeded Romanian overflight 9 Sep). No scheduled catalyst on 1-2 Oct. No matching market exists.
calls.reconciliation: Three disputes. (1) FACTUAL, event list: Run 1 had 6 downing-days, Runs 2 and 3 had 8, adding 8 Jun Latvia (French Rafale) and 14 Aug Latvia (Italian Eurofighter). Two runs with independent corroboration beat one run whose own notes show it never surfaced those events; settled for 8, which raises the base rate above Run 1's. (2) FACTUAL, 26 Jul Romania inside the 12nm territorial sea: not settleable from the dossiers and no web access this run; it moves one of eight events and shifts the rate under 1pp, so it is carried as uncertainty rather than decided. (3) JUDGMENT, regime choice and forward direction: the 1 Jul Ankara delegation of engagement authority to SACEUR/CAOC Uedem is a documented break coinciding with 0 downings Jan-Apr vs 6 since July, so post-July is the right class; on whether the forward rate exceeds trailing, rising incursions and pre-authorised shoot-down orders point up while the 36-day lull since 15 Sep points down, no evidence breaks it, and I read them as near-cancelling with a small autumn tilt. Landed at 13%: above the pooled midpoint because Run 1's number rests on an undercounted event list, below a naive Poisson 14% because downings arrive in bursts. All three runs agree the 20 Aug Neptun Deep kill was a surface drone and excluded it, correctly. No market matches the contract's kinetic-only, over-NATO-territory, 48-hour terms.

disagreements.verdict: Resolved to 8; Run 1 omitted 8 Jun Latvia and 14 Aug Latvia, both corroborated by two sources in Run 2 and listed in Run 3. Run 1's base rate is correspondingly understated.

disagreements.claim: The 26 Jul Romanian Black Sea engagement occurred inside Romania's territorial sea
disagreements.verdict: Could not be settled — no web access and the dossiers conflict (Run 1 explicitly unverified, Run 3 asserts 'off Sulina'). Impact under 1pp; left as uncertainty.

disagreements.claim: The 20 Aug Neptun Deep object was a UAV and should count
disagreements.verdict: No dispute — all three identify it as a maritime surface drone; excluded from every count.

disagreements.claim: The correct anchor is trailing-90-day (Run 1) vs post-1-July regime (Runs 2, 3)
disagreements.verdict: Post-July, on the documented Ankara delegation of engagement authority plus the sharp 0-to-6 discontinuity.

disagreements.claim: The forward rate exceeds the trailing post-July rate
disagreements.verdict: Unbroken tie — rising incursions, looser ROE and the autumn strike ramp point up; the one-downing-in-36-days lull, itself inside the hardened-ROE period, points down. Treated as near-cancelling with a small net upward tilt.

calls.reference_class: 48-hour windows under the post-July-2026 NATO engagement-authority regime containing at least one kinetic NATO downing of a Russian/Belarusian/war-linked UAV over NATO land or territorial sea
